text: 俗話說「三個臭皮匠，勝過一個○○○」，空格裡該填哪位三國人物？
gloss: The saying 'three cobblers beat one ___': which Three Kingdoms figure goes in the blank? — Zhuge Liang: 'three humble cobblers together beat one Zhuge Liang'.

text: 桌上有三顆橘子，你拿走了兩顆。現在，你手上有幾顆橘子？
gloss: Three oranges on the table, you take two. How many do you hold? — Two: the question asks what you have, not what is left on the table.

text: 現在手搖飲店裡 Q 彈的「珍珠」，主要是用哪一種植物的澱粉做成的？
gloss: The chewy 'pearls' in bubble tea are mainly made from the starch of which plant? — Cassava (tapioca), called 樹薯 in Taiwan; bubble tea was invented in Taiwan.

text: 鯨魚雖然生活在海裡，卻屬於哪一類動物？
gloss: Though it lives in the sea, a whale is which kind of animal? — A mammal: it breathes air and nurses its young; the word 'fish' in its Chinese name is the trap.

text: 「木」加「木」是「林」，再多一棵就成了「森」。仔細數數，「森」字一共由幾個「木」組成？
gloss: Tree + tree = grove (林); one more makes forest (森). How many 木 are in 森? — Three: the characters are built by stacking the same component.

text: 台灣的統一發票每兩個月開獎一次。一年有十二個月，總共會開幾次獎？
gloss: Taiwan's receipt lottery is drawn every two months; how many draws in a twelve-month year? — Six (12 ÷ 2); 十二次 is the trap for players who ignore 'every two months'.

text: 地圖上，哪個國家的形狀就像一隻伸入地中海的靴子？
gloss: On the map, which country looks like a boot reaching into the Mediterranean? — Italy. The other options are also Mediterranean peninsulas.

text: 元宵節時，新北市平溪最出名的活動是施放什麼？
gloss: At the Lantern Festival, what is Pingxi (New Taipei) most famous for releasing? — Sky lanterns. Water lanterns belong to Keelung's Ghost Festival and bee-rocket firecrackers to Yanshui in Tainan.

text: 皮克斯動畫《玩具總動員》裡，那位頭戴牛仔帽的玩具主角叫什麼名字？
gloss: In Pixar's Toy Story, what is the cowboy-hat-wearing toy lead called? — Woody (胡迪 in Taiwan). The others are also Toy Story toys: Buzz, Rex, Slinky Dog.

text: 棒球比賽中，守方讓攻方累積幾人出局，就會攻守交換？
gloss: In baseball, after how many outs do the teams switch between batting and fielding? — Three.

text: 〈月亮代表我的心〉最廣為人知的版本，是出自哪位歌手之口？
gloss: Whose voice gave 'The Moon Represents My Heart' its best-known version? — Teresa Teng (鄧麗君); the other options are major Taiwanese singers with their own signature songs.

text: 造紙術、印刷術、火藥，再加上什麼，合稱中國古代的四大發明？
gloss: Papermaking, printing, gunpowder and what else are China's Four Great Inventions? — The compass. Abacus, porcelain and silk are Chinese too but not on the list.

text: 民國元年是西元 1912 年。那麼，西元 2024 年是民國幾年？
gloss: Republic of China year 1 is 1912 CE; what ROC year is 2024? — Year 113: 2024 − 1912 + 1 (year 1 counts, so adding 1 avoids the off-by-one trap 112).

text: 台灣沿海居民世代敬奉，被尊稱為「天上聖母」的海上守護神是哪一位？
gloss: Which sea guardian, revered along Taiwan's coast, is honoured as 'Holy Mother of Heaven'? — Mazu (媽祖). Guanyin, the Queen Mother of the West and Tudigong are other deities people might mix up.

text: 一張正方形的桌子，沿著一條直線鋸掉其中一個角，切口兩端落在相鄰的兩條邊上。桌面現在有幾個角？
gloss: A square table has one corner sawn off in a straight line across two adjacent sides; how many corners now? — Five: one corner is removed but the cut adds two new ones.

text: 超商的飲料每瓶 30 元，現在「買二送一」。買了三瓶，平均每瓶多少元？
gloss: A drink costs 30 dollars, 'buy two get one free'. Average price per bottle for three? — 20 (you pay for two: 60 ÷ 3).

text: 不小心刪掉了一整段文字，在電腦上按下 Ctrl+Z 通常能做什麼？
gloss: You accidentally delete a whole paragraph; what does Ctrl+Z usually do? — Undo the last action.

text: 畫出《向日葵》與《星夜》的畫家梵谷，是哪個國家的人？
gloss: Which country was Van Gogh, painter of Sunflowers and The Starry Night, from? — The Netherlands; France is the trap because he painted there.

text: 《瑪利歐兄弟》裡的瑪利歐與路易吉，在故事設定中是什麼職業？
gloss: In Mario Bros., what is the job of Mario and Luigi? — Plumbers (the carpenter option is a nod to Mario's very first appearance, which the question rules out by naming Mario Bros.).

text: 昆蟲的身體分成頭、胸、腹三部分，並且有六隻腳。下列哪一種動物不是昆蟲？
gloss: Insects have head, thorax and abdomen and six legs; which of these is not an insect? — The spider: two body parts and eight legs, an arachnid.

text: 台南的安平古堡，前身是十七世紀的「熱蘭遮城」，它是哪個國家的人建造的？
gloss: Anping Fort in Tainan grew out of 17th-century Fort Zeelandia; which country's people built it? — The Dutch. Spain built forts in the north (Keelung, Tamsui), which is the trap.

text: 年輕人常用數字「5201314」傳情。把每個數字用國語唸出來，它諧音的是哪一句話？
gloss: Young people text '5201314' as a love code; read each digit aloud in Mandarin, which sentence does it sound like? — 'I love you for a lifetime' (wu-er-ling-yi-san-yi-si ≈ 我愛你一生一世).

text: 閃電亮起後，你數到 6 秒才聽見雷聲。聲音大約每秒走三分之一公里，雷擊處離你大約多遠？
gloss: You count 6 seconds between lightning and thunder, sound travels about a third of a kilometre per second; how far is the strike? — About 2 km (6 × 1/3); light arrives practically instantly.

text: 《小王子》裡，被小王子澆水、罩上玻璃罩細心照顧的，是什麼植物？
gloss: In The Little Prince, which plant does he water and cover with a glass globe? — His rose. The baobab is the weed he pulls up.

text: 余光中的詩〈鄉愁〉寫道：「長大後，鄉愁是一張窄窄的○○」，空格裡是什麼？
gloss: Yu Kwang-chung's 'Nostalgia': 'When grown up, nostalgia is a narrow ___' — A ticket for a ship (船票). The poem's four stanzas run: stamp, ship ticket, grave, strait.

text: 羅馬數字裡，I 是 1、V 是 5、X 是 10、L 是 50。那麼 XLIV 代表哪個數字？
gloss: Given I=1, V=5, X=10, L=50, what is XLIV? — 44: a smaller numeral before a larger one is subtracted (XL = 40, IV = 4); simply adding gives the trap 66.

text: 十二月的某一天，台北時間是上午 9 點整，同一時刻的倫敦是幾點？
gloss: On a December day it is 9:00 a.m. in Taipei; what time is it in London at that moment? — 1:00 a.m. (Taiwan is UTC+8, London UTC+0 in winter; London is behind, so subtract).

text: 台灣積體電路製造（台積電）於 1987 年創立，創辦人是誰？
gloss: TSMC was founded in 1987; who founded it? — Morris Chang (張忠謀). The others founded Foxconn, Acer and Formosa Plastics.

text: 設計了巴塞隆納奎爾公園，並接手興建聖家堂的建築師是誰？
gloss: Which architect designed Park Güell in Barcelona and took over the Sagrada Família? — Antoni Gaudí. Calatrava is another Spanish architect, the trap.

text: 4/4 拍的一小節裡有四拍，每一拍是一個四分音符。如果全部改寫成八分音符，一小節能寫幾個？
gloss: A 4/4 bar has four quarter-note beats; rewritten entirely in eighth notes, how many fit? — Eight (an eighth note is half a quarter note); 16 would be sixteenth notes.

text: 李安曾兩度獲得奧斯卡最佳導演獎，他第一次得獎是憑哪一部電影？
gloss: Ang Lee has won the Best Director Oscar twice; for which film did he win it first? — Brokeback Mountain (2005 film, awarded 2006); Life of Pi came later, while Crouching Tiger won other Oscars but not his.

text: 非洲面積最大的國家是哪一個？
gloss: Which is the largest country in Africa by area? — Algeria (Sudan held the title until 2011); DR Congo is second.

text: 1911 年率領探險隊首度抵達南極點的是哪位探險家？
gloss: Which explorer led the first expedition to reach the South Pole in 1911? — Roald Amundsen. Scott arrived a month later; Shackleton never reached it; Peary claimed the North Pole.

text: 歌手齊豫唱紅的〈橄欖樹〉，歌詞是由哪位作家所寫？
gloss: Who wrote the lyrics of 'The Olive Tree', made famous by the singer Chyi Yu?— The writer Sanmao (music by Li Tai-hsiang). The others are well-known Taiwanese women writers.

text: 號稱世界上最昂貴的香料之一的番紅花，我們拿來入菜的是花的哪一個部位？
gloss: Saffron is among the world's priciest spices; which part of the flower is used? — The stigmas (柱頭), picked by hand.

text: 古人把一天分成十二個時辰，每個時辰兩小時。「子時」是深夜十一點到凌晨一點，照著十二地支的順序往下數，「午時」是幾點到幾點？
options: 上午 11 點至下午 1 點
gloss: The ancient day has twelve two-hour periods; 子 is 23:00–01:00. Counting the earthly branches, what hours is 午? — 11:00–13:00 (子, 丑, 寅, 卯, 辰, 巳, 午: the seventh period; 午 also means noon).

text: 台灣選手首度在奧運奪得金牌，是在 2004 年雅典奧運的哪一個項目？
gloss: In which event did Taiwanese athletes win their first Olympic gold, at Athens 2004? — Taekwondo (Chu Mu-yen and Chen Shih-hsin). Weightlifting and badminton golds came later.

text: 在海拔將近 4,000 公尺的高山上燒開水，水大約在幾度時就會沸騰？
gloss: Boiling water on a mountain of nearly 4,000 m, at about what temperature does it boil? — About 87 °C: air pressure is roughly 60% of sea level, so water boils lower (about 1 °C per 300 m).

text: 下列哪一種動物的血液因為含銅而呈現藍色？
gloss: Which animal has blue blood because it carries copper? — The octopus (haemocyanin instead of iron-based haemoglobin).

text: 夏至那天的正午，北回歸線通過的嘉義水上，一根垂直立著的竹竿，影子會變成怎樣？
gloss: At noon on the summer solstice in Shuishang, Chiayi, which the Tropic of Cancer crosses, what happens to the shadow of a vertical pole? — It shrinks to almost nothing: the Sun is directly overhead on the Tropic at the solstice.

text: 古人用「古稀」稱七十歲，那麼稱一百歲的雅稱是什麼？
gloss: Old age has elegant names: 古稀 is seventy; what is the name for a hundred? — 期頤 (from the Book of Rites). 花甲 is sixty, 喜壽 seventy-seven, 米壽 eighty-eight.

text: 台北 101 的外形取意於節節高升的竹子，主要的建築設計師是誰？
gloss: Taipei 101's form evokes rising bamboo; who was its principal architect? — C.Y. Lee (李祖原). The others are well-known Chinese-born or Taiwanese architects.

text: 冬天湖面結了冰，在夠深的湖裡，湖底的水溫通常大約是幾度？
gloss: A deep lake is frozen over in winter; what is the water temperature at the bottom? — About 4 °C: water is densest at 4 °C, so it sinks, while colder water floats to the top and freezes.

text: 第一位獲得諾貝爾文學獎的華語作家是誰？
gloss: Who was the first Chinese-language writer to win the Nobel Prize in Literature? — Gao Xingjian (2000); Mo Yan followed in 2012; Lu Xun and Ba Jin never won.

text: 有一種國家被稱為「雙重內陸國」：自己不靠海，鄰國也都不靠海。下列哪個國家就是？
gloss: A 'doubly landlocked' country has no coast and all its neighbours have none either; which of these is one? — Liechtenstein (bordered only by Switzerland and Austria). Switzerland touches France and Italy, Luxembourg touches Belgium and France.

text: 俄國作曲家史特拉汶斯基的芭蕾舞劇《春之祭》，1913 年首演時因前衛的音樂與舞蹈引起觀眾騷動，地點是哪座城市？
gloss: Stravinsky's ballet The Rite of Spring caused an uproar at its 1913 premiere; in which city? — Paris (Théâtre des Champs-Élysées); St Petersburg is the trap because of the composer's nationality.

text: 北歐神話中的眾神之王奧丁，為了換取智慧之泉的泉水，付出了什麼代價？
gloss: In Norse myth, what did Odin give up to drink from the well of wisdom? — One of his eyes. A hand was lost by Tyr to the wolf Fenrir, the trap.

text: 和日本麻將不同，台灣麻將每位玩家手中握十六張牌。胡牌時，連同最後摸進或胡進的那張，手上共有幾張牌？
gloss: Taiwanese mahjong players hold sixteen tiles; including the winning tile, how many tiles are in a winning hand? — Seventeen: five sets of three plus a pair (15 + 2); 14 is the Japanese count.

text: 約 1450 年前後，古騰堡在德國哪座城市發展出歐洲的活字印刷術，印出了知名的《聖經》？
gloss: Around 1450 Gutenberg developed European movable-type printing in which German city, printing his famous Bible? — Mainz; Frankfurt (home of the book fair) is the trap.

text: 32 隊參賽的世界盃足球賽，先分成 8 個小組，每組 4 隊彼此各踢一場。整屆賽事（含季軍賽）總共踢幾場比賽？
gloss: A 32-team World Cup: 8 groups of 4, everyone plays everyone once; how many matches in the whole tournament including the third-place match? — 64: 48 in groups plus 16 knockout games (8+4+2+1+1).
